name: dottie-monorepo
description: Root task names required by brief §23. Each one delegates to the package that owns it; packages keep their own lockfiles.

scripts.bootstrap: npm ci --prefix packages/contracts && npm ci --prefix packages/codex-adapter && npm ci --prefix packages/coordinator && npm ci --prefix apps/desktop && python3 -m pip install -e "packages/verifier[dev]" && python3 -m pip install "pytest>=8.0"
scripts.typecheck: npm run check --prefix packages/contracts && npm run check --prefix packages/codex-adapter && npm run check --prefix packages/coordinator && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/desktop && cd packages/verifier && python3 -m ruff check . && cd ../.. && python3 -m ruff check scripts docs
scripts.unit-test: npm test --prefix packages/contracts && npm test --prefix packages/codex-adapter && npm test --prefix packages/coordinator && npm test --prefix apps/desktop && (cd packages/tools && python3 -m pytest -q) && (cd packages/verifier && python3 -m pytest -q)
scripts.windows-e2e: echo 'not implemented (DOT-040; needs Gopi PC)' && exit 1
scripts.package: echo 'not implemented (DOT-050); see apps/desktop package:win' && exit 1
